import { type CollectionCommand, type CollectionProps, type CollectionState } from '../contract.js';

export function createCollection<T extends Record<string, any>>(props: CollectionProps<T>): CollectionState {
    const creating = signal(false);

    const getCommand = <I, O>(c: CollectionCommand<I, O> | BoundCommand<I, O> | undefined): BoundCommand<I, O> | undefined => {
        if (!c) return undefined;
        if ('command' in c) return c.command;
        return c;
    };

    const createCmd = getCommand(props.create);
    const updateCmd = getCommand(props.update);

    const derivedSchema = props.schema ?? (createCmd ? extractCommandJsonSchema(createCmd.output) : undefined) ?? (updateCmd ? extractCommandJsonSchema(updateCmd.output) : undefined);
    const propsMap = getProperties(derivedSchema);

    const getTitleStr = () => {
        const t = read(props.title);
        return typeof t === 'string' ? t : '';
    };
    
    const getScopeStr = () => {
        const s = read(props.scope);
        return s === null ? 'Select scope' : s;
    };

    const header = (): Node =>
        element('Row', {
            props: { class: 'collection-header', style: { display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', padding: '16px' } },
            children: [
                element('Stack', {
                    props: { class: 'ui-collection-title' },
                    children: [
                        element('Heading', { props: { level: 1 }, children: [text(getTitleStr)] }),
                        element('Text', {
                            props: { class: 'ui-collection-subtitle' },
                            children: [text(getScopeStr)],
                        }),
                    ],
                }),
                when(
                    () => createCmd !== undefined,
                    () => {
                        const btnText = () => {
                            const avail = createCmd!.available();
                            const refusal = avail.can ? undefined : formatRefusal(avail);
                            let base = `New ${getTitleStr().toLowerCase().replace(/s$/, '')}`;
                            if (props.create && 'title' in props.create && props.create.title) {
                                base = String(read(props.create.title));
                            }
                            return refusal ? `${base} — ${refusal}` : base;
                        };
                        return element('Button', {
                            props: {
                                class: 'ui-collection-btn primary ui-button ui-button-primary',
                                disabled: () => creating() || !createCmd!.available().can,
                                'data-refused': () => (!createCmd!.available().can ? 'true' : 'false'),
                                title: () => {
                                    const avail = createCmd!.available();
                                    return avail.can ? '' : formatRefusal(avail);
                                },
                            },
                            intents: { activate: { action: props.on(() => { creating.set(true); }) } },
                            children: [text(btnText)],
                        });
                    }
                )
            ],
        });

    const createFormNode = (): Node => {
        if (!createCmd) return text('');
        let title = `New ${getTitleStr().toLowerCase().replace(/s$/, '')}`;
        if (props.create && 'title' in props.create && props.create.title) {
            title = String(read(props.create.title));
        }
        return element('Stack', {
            props: { class: 'ui-collection-create' },
            children: [
                ActionCard({
                    on: props.on,
                    command: createCmd,
                    title: title,
                    onResult: () => { creating.set(false); },
                    onSecondary: () => { creating.set(false); },
                }),
            ],
        });
    };

    const getSelectedRow = (): T | undefined => {
        const sel = read(props.selected);
        if (sel === null || sel === undefined) return undefined;
        return read(props.rows).find(r => props.rowKey(r) === sel);
    };

    const keys = Object.keys(propsMap).filter(k => !props.exclude.includes(k as keyof T));
    const gridItems: PropertyGridItem[] = keys.map(k => {
        const schemaProp = propsMap[k];
        const labelStr = schemaProp?.title ?? humanizeLabel(k);
        return {
            label: labelStr,
            value: () => {
                const r = getSelectedRow();
                return r ? String((r as any)[k] ?? '—') : '—';
            }
        };
    });

    const detailNode = (): Node => {
        return DetailSurface({
            selected: () => getSelectedRow() !== undefined,
            placeholderTitle: () => {
                if (props.detailPlaceholderTitle) return String(read(props.detailPlaceholderTitle));
                return `Select a ${getTitleStr().toLowerCase().replace(/s$/, '')}`;
            },
            placeholderMessage: 'Pick one on the left to see its details.',
            title: () => {
                const r = getSelectedRow();
                return r ? props.rowTitle(r) : '';
            },
            subtitle: () => {
                const r = getSelectedRow();
                return r && props.rowDescription ? props.rowDescription(r) : '';
            },
            children: [
                element('Stack', {
                    props: { style: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '20px' } },
                    children: [
                        PropertyGrid({ items: gridItems }),
                        ...(() => {
                            const r = getSelectedRow();
                            if (r && props.detailChildren) {
                                return props.detailChildren(r);
                            }
                            return [];
                        })()
                    ],
                }),
            ],
        });
    };

    const indexNode = (): Node => {
        return EntityList({
            title: getTitleStr,
            status: props.status,
            count: () => read(props.rows).length,
            errorMessage: () => read(props.error),
            loadingMessage: `Loading ${getTitleStr().toLowerCase()}…`,
            emptyMessage: props.emptyMessage ?? `No ${getTitleStr().toLowerCase()} yet.`,
            width: 280,
            children: [
                each(
                    props.rows,
                    (r: T) => props.rowKey(r),
                    (r: () => T) => EntityItem({
                        title: () => props.rowTitle(r()),
                        description: () => props.rowDescription ? props.rowDescription(r()) : '',
                        selected: () => read(props.selected) === props.rowKey(r()),
                        intents: { activate: { action: props.on(() => props.onSelect?.(props.rowKey(r()))) } },
                    })
                )
            ]
        });
    };

    const view = (): Node => {
        return element('Stack', {
            props: { class: 'ui-collection', style: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%' } },
            children: [
                header(),
                when(() => creating(), createFormNode),
                element('Row', {
                    props: { class: 'ui-collection-body', style: { display: 'flex', flex: '1', minHeight: '0' } },
                    children: [indexNode(), detailNode()],
                }),
            ],
        });
    };

    return { view };
}

export function Collection<T extends Record<string, any>>(props: CollectionProps<T>): Node {
    return createCollection(props).view();
}
